groundPathways.description: Floor pathway tiles in three visual variant rows. Each row has the same 5-tile pattern: straight, right-curve, T-junction (right-facing), four-way intersection (cross), end-cap. Variant identities: variant 1 (row 0) = structured road tiles; variant 2 (row 1) = dirt / unstructured path tiles; variant 3 (row 2) = alternate variant of the structured road (visual alternative to variant 1). Useful for connected-path rendering in dungeons or the open world. Sits directly to the right of naturalTerrain (cols 0-7). All 15 tiles are also promoted to environment.path* (canonical refs).

buildingWallStructure.description: 3x3 brick interior-room composite. One of the room/dungeon footprint sets (others elsewhere on the sheet). Corner + edge tiles carry the brick pattern only on the outward-facing side with transparent inward edges, so they read as walls a player walks alongside. The center tile is a fuller brick interior with light transparency around its border. Compose as a 3x3 footprint to give the appearance of a walkable enclosed room. First tile (col 18, row 0) is the top-left corner, last tile (col 20, row 2) is the bottom-right corner.
